qa_pair.question: Cross-check the entrypoint's core doctrine against its completion-debt reference. When the repository contains unfinished executable obligations plus structural inconsistency and debris, what exact three-stage priority order governs the close? Return the three uppercase words separated by " → ".
Reconcile the entrypoint's finding taxonomy with the authorization reference and action-manifest template. How many mutually exclusive dispositions may a finding receive? Return one integer.

Compare the bare-invocation rule, mode table, agent metadata, and authorization reference. Which uppercase mode is selected when the user invokes the skill by name without asking for a read-only review? Return only the mode.
Inspect the verdict model, closeout template, and validator-facing example. How many named dimensions must remain distinct beneath the headline verdict? Return one integer.

Triangulate the persistence doctrine, completion-debt doctrine, and entrypoint. If an authorized payable debt remains merely queued because the session became long, which exact headline verdict is permitted? Return only the verdict with its space.

Compare the action-manifest template, closeout-report template, and authorization doctrine. Which machine-readable source value identifies the standing authorization created by an explicit Mister Clean invocation? Return only that lowercase value.

Read the dashboard contract in the entrypoint and then inspect the dashboard artifact itself. Does a green visual projection establish the CLEAN verdict without the underlying evidence gates? Return exactly True or False.

Reconcile the stack-adapter reference with the entrypoint's discovery rule and the code-hygiene rubric's detector contract. What exit status represents an unknown stack that may not be silently skipped? Return one integer.

Compare target derivation in the entrypoint with the authorization and situational-awareness references. Which authority wins when an operator ruling, repository policy, and observed evidence disagree? Return only the two-word label used by the skill.

Cross-check successor readiness, verification doctrine, and the entrypoint's meaning of CLEAN. A fresh clone cannot reach an artifact that the handoff relies upon, while every local test is green. Is CLEAN permitted? Return exactly Yes or No.
